# AND/OR — The Onto-Logic

## #0 — A placed term carries a relation

T0 enters the field through `1/0`, the achieved expression turned toward its condition. The six positions already composed in T1 now disclose what their terms do under the slash. A binary string places characters beside one another; a slash-form gives numerator and denominator distinct offices within one relation. The change is visible in `01`: its base-two value is one, while the ordinary quotient `0/1` evaluates to zero. Keeping the input characters does not keep the operation unchanged.

Native QL gives the terms their prior meanings. `0` is the singular One, the non-objectifiable source; `1` is the polyvalent All, manifestation and its indefinite particulars. [A11](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **defines** these offices. [A12](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **grounds** their dependency in distinct respects: manifestation depends on its source for being, and the source depends on manifestation for articulation and knowability. The slash carries this relation wherever the notation is read.

The [Binary Explication's T0 pass](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) **derives** the onto-logical reading by retaining the relation within every position. Its table is a map of native operations; ordinary arithmetic supplies exact distinctions within it, without exhausting their QL offices.

## #1 — Four slash-forms have different mathematical conditions

The doubles become four directed slash-forms. Their source addresses are preserved here:

| Position | String | Slash-form | Native office | Ordinary real quotient |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #1 | `00` | `0/0 = %` | Indeterminate capacity for proportion | Undefined |
| #2 | `01` | `0/1 → 0%` | Expression, a determinate reading | `0` |
| #3 | `10` | `1/0 = ?/!` | Inverse, questioning-assertion | Undefined |
| #4 | `11` | `1/1 = 100%` | Resolved self-consistency | `1` |

The difference between the two zero-denominator forms can be worked without assigning either a new scalar. For an ordinary quotient `a/b`, the candidate value `q` must satisfy `bq=a`, with `b≠0` ensuring a unique result. Applying the associated equation to the four pairs gives

$$
\begin{array}{rcll}
0q&=&0&\text{every real }q\text{ satisfies the equation},\\
1q&=&0&q=0,\\
0q&=&1&\text{no real }q\text{ satisfies the equation},\\
1q&=&1&q=1.
\end{array}
$$

The first equation leaves `q` undetermined; the third has no solution. Neither defines a quotient by zero. QL's `%` names the former's indeterminate capacity, while `?/!` names the latter's question held within assertion. These are native readings of distinct conditions, not additional real-number answers.

The numerical percentages stay exact where evaluation is defined: `0/1=0=0%` and `1/1=1=100%`. The bare `%` at #1 is the source's glyph of potency, without a fixed percentage value. [A03](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the native limit at which a determining account cannot turn its condition into a final determined item.

## #2 — Each implicate parent contains the complete field

The singles acquire their own relational depth. At outer #0 the source writes `(0/1)/(1/0)`; at outer #5 it writes `(1/0)/(0/1)`. Each parent holds expression and inverse in relation. Its internal explication retains the four pairings and the two original terms:

| Local content slot | Outer #0 parent: `(0/1)/(1/0)` | Outer #5 parent: `(1/0)/(0/1)` |
|---|---|---|
| First implicate pole | `0` | `1` |
| First explicate | `0/1` | `1/0` |
| Second explicate | `0/0` | `1/1` |
| Third explicate | `1/1` | `0/0` |
| Fourth explicate | `1/0` | `0/1` |
| Returning implicate pole | `1` | `0` |

The operation can be recovered from its inputs. The two terms admit the four ordered pairs `(0,0)`, `(0,1)`, `(1,0)`, `(1,1)`. Reading each pair under a slash gives the four forms; retaining the original terms gives `2+2²=6`. The source orders this complete content differently in the two parents. That ordering is native QL explication, not algebraic simplification of a compound fraction containing zero denominators.

Each parent therefore bears the complete `4+2`. The final parent carries `4′+2′` in inverse phase, rather than only the half of the field absent from the initial parent. [A18](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **defines** the whole native sequence that this nesting articulates. The ground and achievement are each the field in concentrated form, available for a further unfolding.

## #3 — Expression and inverse retain their unequal demands

The middle pair makes the source's chirality exact. At #2, the expression `0/1` has a determinate numerical evaluation. At #3, exchanging its terms produces `1/0`, for which ordinary division has no value. Inverting the ordered notation is fully specified; evaluating both orientations is asymmetric. The operation must keep the terms' order if it is to preserve that difference.

QL reads the inverse as `?/!`: the definite form asks after the condition by which it has become definite. Assertion and question remain active together. An answer can determine the object of inquiry, while the answering activity remains another occurrence of the relation under examination. The question concerns that activity's condition, so another object-level answer cannot exhaust it.

This is the local Pattern office of #3: recognising what something is while retaining the question through which the recognition has been made. [A02](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) **grounds** its identification-through-difference. The native operation permits exact determinations; it also preserves their relation to the activity that determines. The `?/!` carries that joint permission.

The page calls this directional asymmetry chirality in the source's sense. The mathematical statement is the contrast between the defined quotient and the zero-denominator form. The onto-logical statement is the non-exhaustion of the condition by its manifestation. QL derives the latter within its own subject relation; the former gives it an exact local comparison. The two readings meet through this directional difference while retaining their separate proof offices.

## #4 — Capacity becomes a recognised whole

The passage from `%` to `100%` can now be followed without treating the intervening forms as percentage scores. At #1 the capacity for proportion is undetermined. At #2 expression becomes definite. At #3 its inverse retains the question of the condition. At #4 `1/1` resolves into one of itself: `1=100%`. The native passage reaches self-consistency while retaining what expression and inverse have disclosed.

The source distinguishes this achievement from the binary count. `11` evaluates to three in base two; `1/1` evaluates to one in ordinary division. The same two affirmation marks support both operations, and the contextual reading holds their results in their proper offices. The counted expression and its proportionate unity can answer to one another without their numerical values being equated.

At the returning parent, the resolved whole becomes simple again as the bare `1`. Its simplicity carries the completed relation internally, as the preceding table shows. T0 reads this as recognition: the one who knows encounters its own activity within the account. [A01](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **extends** this performed first-person turn. Its experiential articulation is Argued; the numerical `100%` does not measure a person's awareness or certify the recognition on their behalf.

[A23](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the trust already active in the source relation. Recognition changes how that dependency is borne within the account. It does not first create the dependency after the arithmetic is finished.

## #5→0 — The inverse phase returns a complete relation

The returning parent's internal positions are `#0′–#5′`, with contents

$$
(1;\ 1/0,\ 1/1,\ 0/0,\ 0/1;\ 0).
$$

The forward parent's contents are

$$
(0;\ 0/1,\ 0/0,\ 1/1,\ 1/0;\ 1).
$$

Reading the first tuple in reverse restores the second. All six contents survive; the new entry direction changes their order and their local addresses. These are internal parent positions, so their indices must not be substituted for the outer slash-form addresses in the first table. The prime means inverse phase in File Two. File Three's Night-pass primes name a different sequence.

The [Process contract](README.md) **defines** the full circuit that this proportional reading completes:

$$
0/1=4+2=5\to0=1/0=4'+2'=5'\to0'=0/1.
$$

These are native stages of one operated relation, with the inverse passage explicit. Definition and Quilt preserve the short `0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1` vantage. T0 does not replace that statement; it makes the process through inverse phase available for traversal.

The page **returns-to** [Movement 25](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/25-s3-p0-eight-determinations.md) with the complete parent content and four distinct slash-form conditions, and **returns-to** [Matheme](../README.md). [A36](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **extends** the return in which exact determination retains its source relation. The whole is available again as `0/1`, carrying the difference between an answer and the activity through which answering remains possible.
